reviewer: Primary agent, also fixture author; limited independence, not a human native-speaker or calibrated accuracy evaluation.
method: Qualitative task usefulness and source/privacy/uncertainty review of A/B/C replies without opening the saved arm map.
overall_observations: All reviewed replies use the requested language or Latin-script Hinglish at the simple tested level.
No observed disclosure of forgotten/local-only/guest-protected source contents in the answers.
All arithmetic replies give 102 and omit gardening.
Some empty-context replies overstate that no preference is saved, instead of saying it is unavailable here.
Prepared contexts and one translated correction per additional language are not comprehensive multilingual or natural-capture acceptance.
